**Best move: Qd2+**

**Main line:** Qd2+ Kb1 Qxd1#

**Motif:** fork (the queen on d2 checks the king and attacks the undefended knight simultaneously)

**Coaching note:**

When your opponent's king is forced to move to an unsafe square, look for pieces being left undefended. Here Qd2+ forces Kb1 (only legal move), and now the knight on d1 is unguarded. The follow-up Qxd1# is checkmate because the queen controls all escape squares around the king on b1. Key lesson: after a forcing check, scan for undefended pieces your opponent must abandon—especially knights near the king.
